summary: End-to-end ML platforms handle the full lifecycle—data prep, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring—at scale, unlike a hosted model API which only gives you inference on a pre-built model. You need a full platform when you train or fine-tune custom models, require governance/compliance, or must manage many models in production; a simple model API suffices when you only consume frontier models for generation or embeddings. In 2026 the market is dominated by the three hyperscaler platforms (Azure ML, SageMaker, Vertex AI/Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) plus Databricks, with specialized and open-source tools clustering below.

platforms.name: Amazon SageMaker (SageMaker AI)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/instance-hour for training, hosting, and notebooks; no upfront cost. Savings plans available.
platforms.best_for: Teams already on AWS needing deep, modular ML tooling and strong production deployment capabilities.

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go compute (per VM/instance-hour); no platform surcharge. Reserved instances and spot available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises embedded in the Microsoft ecosystem needing strong governance and lifecycle management (highest GigaOm enterprise-readiness score, 2.95/3).

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/node-hour and per prediction; GenAI billed per token. No upfront cost.
platforms.best_for: GCP-native teams wanting tightly integrated feature store, opinionated pipelines, and managed GenAI/agent workflows.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBU (Databricks Unit) pricing on top of underlying cloud compute; tiered by workload.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting a unified lakehouse where data, analytics, ML, and GenAI share one governed platform, often multi-cloud.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; costs are only your own infrastructure (or bundled into managed Databricks).
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, framework-agnostic standard for experiment tracking and model registry across any stack.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases (CoreWeave)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based subscription for teams and enterprise.
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking, visualization, and collaboration across any training stack.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription / contract-based (custom quote); consumption tiers available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated ML and managed infrastructure without heavy MLOps engineering overhead.

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; cost is your Kubernetes infrastructure and operational overhead.
platforms.best_for: Teams with strong DevOps/Kubernetes skills wanting a portable, cloud-agnostic, open-source MLOps stack.

platforms.name: Dataiku
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription / contract-based (custom quote); free edition available.
platforms.best_for: Cross-functional teams (analysts + data scientists) wanting a visual, collaborative, end-to-end data science platform.

platforms.name: Domino Data Lab
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises (finance, pharma, life sciences) needing reproducibility, governance, and hybrid/on-prem control.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core (H2O-3) free; enterprise AutoML and GenAI products are subscription/contract-based.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting automated ML with strong explainability plus open-source flexibility and GenAI tooling.

platforms.name: BentoML
platforms.pricing: Open source free; BentoCloud managed serving is usage-based.
platforms.best_for: Engineering teams that train elsewhere but need flexible, framework-agnostic model packaging and high-performance serving.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based, per-second serverless compute billing (GPU/CPU); generous free credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting serverless, code-first GPU infrastructure for training, fine-tuning, and deploying models without managing clusters.

notable_sonnet_additions: Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI)
